checks.details: The local Smart policy classified a live TH17 base after three accepted zoom gestures and 240 red-line points, then deterministically selected the BL side nearest the Town Hall.

The run quantity-proved 23 deployable troops to zero in two reads, recorded all four selected Hero phase commands, proved Rage 3-to-zero and Freeze 5-to-4, and disabled further Freeze clicks when a later decrement was not confirmed.

Exactly one battle completed at two stars and 55 percent, telemetry recorded one search and credited loot, and the engine stopped itself on battle-limit with the session cleared and BlueStacks stable.

notes: Automated mechanics evidence from one bounded TH17 current-army Smart battle. This does not establish strategy superiority, other Town Halls or armies, broader fixture coverage, or human visual acceptance.
